title: Retry cannot accept or charge an action against a deleted demo
steps: Accept an action and give it a failed terminal state and a build marked deleted.
Retry with a new request ID, once with state deleted and once with demo_deleted_at set.
expect: Both requests return 409 DEMO_DELETED and direct the caller to Rebuild.
Neither request creates an action or increases usage; live or never-provisioned retries keep existing behavior.
evidence: The local Joomla acceptance received 202 for a deleted Via Carota build, then chat/prepare refused AGENT_DEMO_NOT_GRANTED.
fence: Acceptance checks deletion under the existing build row lock, before action and usage writes.

tests: Retry refuses a deleted build before accepting or charging another action
